Fist Recruit Pavel is a human ranger and a recruit of the Flaming Fist. He is on the Risen Road in Act One.
“
Watch it, that was my foot!
„
— Pavel, pushing against a door

Involvement

Pavel is at Waukeen's Rest, struggling to get inside the burning inn together with his fellow Fists -  Fist Recruit Aelis,  Fist Recruit Ito and  Fist Recruit Tristan, along with  Gauntlet Yeva. They are trying to rescue  Counsellor Florrick and  Duke Ravengard who are said to be blocked inside the building.

If a party member helps the Fists to unblock the front door, Pavel with the rest of the squad runs upstairs to the room where Florrick is trapped, and descends back after the counsellor’s fate is resolved.

If Florrick survives, Pavel receives his orders (with the other Fists) to search for the kidnapped Duke and, after leaving the Inn, is never seen again.
